objective: Run a deep self-audit over the current YADO kernel and all remote branches, classify each branch as active, memory, history, or withheld, refresh canonical branch lifecycle state, pass full audit and regression, then start the next bounded development cycle.
required_sequence: classify all branches by ancestry, registered experience and changed paths
select next development deficit and generate bounded development plan
persist deterministic branch lifecycle and memory index
merge to main only after all gates pass

branch_policy.active: main plus verified divergent candidates that still require admission
branch_policy.history: absorbed or infrastructure refs preserved in Git history
